ModMetaData.name: Clean Pathfinding - Glow Cache Optimizer
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Standalone performance companion for Clean Pathfinding 2 on RimWorld 1.5.4063. Caches Clean Pathfinding's per-cell GameGlowAtFast result for 30 ticks per map to reduce repeated glow-grid work inside PathFinder cost evaluation. Clean Pathfinding remains authoritative on cache misses. No RimMT dependency or diagnostics hook.
